name: Venera-7
about: Venera-7 (1970-060A, IKI/BABTS), launched 1970 Aug 17. Its phases from GCAT: Venus, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.692 au and aphelion 1.013 au against GCAT's 0.690 and 1.010
